claim.claim-text: 1. A method for culturing a stem cell, comprising a step of culturing a stem cell on a scaffolding material in a serum-free medium containing no feeder cell or adhesive protein,

the scaffolding material comprising a synthetic resin, and the scaffolding material having a dispersion component γ of surface free energy of 28.0 or more and less than 38.0, and a dipole component γ

of surface free energy of 1.0 or more and less than 10.0.
2. The method for culturing a stem cell according to claim 1, wherein the stem cell is a pluripotent stem cell, preferably an induced pluripotent stem cell.
3. The method for culturing a stem cell according to claim 1 or 2, wherein the synthetic resin contains at least any one of a polyvinyl acetal skeleton and a poly(meth)acrylic ester skeleton.
4. The method for culturing a stem cell according to claim 1 or 2, wherein the synthetic resin is a polyvinyl acetal resin.
5. The method for culturing a stem cell according to claim 4, wherein a degree of acetalization of the polyvinyl acetal resin being higher than 60 mol%.

6. The method for culturing a stem cell according to claim 4 or 5, wherein the polyvinyl acetal resin contains as a structural unit at least one selected from the group consisting of a structural unit having an amine structure, a structural unit having an imine structure and a structural unit having an amide structure.

7. The method for culturing a stem cell according to claim 6, wherein the polyvinyl acetal resin has a total content of the structural unit having an amine structure, the structural unit having an imine structure and the structural unit having an amide structure of 0.1 mol% or more and 30 mol% or less.
8. The method for culturing a stem cell according to any one of claims 1 to 7, wherein the scaffolding material is a resin film.
9. The method for culturing a stem cell according to claim 8, wherein the resin film is provided on at least a part of a cell culture region of a container.
10. The method for culturing a stem cell according to any one of claims 1 to 7, wherein the scaffolding material is a fiber.
11. The method for culturing a stem cell according to any one of claims 1 to 10, comprising a step of seeding a cell mass on the scaffolding material for culturing a stem cell.
